text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp draws to a close... 
To wrap it all up, Agnes Digital decided 
to do a tandem training session with King 
Halo.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*pant, whew*... King-san, thanks for the 
match~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*pant, whew*... Digital, you hesitated 
quite a lot during your run. What 
happened?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, that's... It was far more precious 
than I could have imagined, so I couldn't 
keep my sanity while running, so to 
speak...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
For someone like me who only ever watched 
from the sidelines... trying to catch up 
to King-san is probably asking for way too 
much, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"'Running for real.' I only just resolved 
myself to do that recently, ordinary girl 
that I am, so..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My, you certainly lack confidence.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Still... is that really all?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I get that you have an inferiority 
complex. But is that really all?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if there wasn't another reason 
you couldn't get into the spirit of 
running today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ugh, that's, uh...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Is this really the best 
Digital-san can do?
choice_data_list:
I shouldn't be able to lose on sand, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!? Uuu, they're closing in on 
me~.

"Even to my eyes, Agnes Digital's running 
was clearly off. The reason for that 
was..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: King-san, umm... Right now, King-san is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...I'm still... far from being at my 
best... aren't I...?
(WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Compared to earlier this spring, when she 
won the Takamatsunomiya Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The elegance of the form... the dynamism 
of the armpits, the sizzling appeal... 
it's all just lacking, somehow...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can tell. I really can. Because I was 
always leaning over the fence watching.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I understand it now! Just how much King is 
suffering right now. Because I... have 
made my debut, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's why...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So... your heart just wasn't in it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Cornering a beloved Umamusume when 
she's feeling vulnerable is something I 
just can't do. That's why...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see... Hehe... Digital-san, you really 
are...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Silly girl.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Dummy. You really are a dummy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You seem to know a lot about me, but you 
don't understand what truly matters.

Harsh words. But contrary to her words, 
King Halo's tone was gentle.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Digital-san, you're interested in 
King here, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Learn more about me before the Mile CS.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What kind of Umamusume this King Halo is, 
through training together with her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh, training with King-san? Even after 
the training camp is over?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then, please! I may have much to 
learn, but I'd love to, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so honored! So honored my tail is 
twitching non-stop! That goddess, together 
with Degitan?!

At the end of summer—a small bond was 
formed with the Umamusume she admired.
